channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Mountainfilm: Commitment Grants & Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship
    https://www.mountainfilm.org/mountainfilm-initiatives/commitment-grants/
    Mountainfilm · deadline Closed 16 Jul 2026 · Over USD 90,000 in total funding. Individual Commitment Grants range from USD 3,000 to 6,000. The Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship adds a yearlong mentorship, a cash award, and a funded trip to Telluride over Memorial Day weekend (travel, lodging, and a festival pass).

item.description:
• The Flaherty: 2026 Fellowship (71st Flaherty Film Seminar)
    https://theflaherty.org/2026-fellowship
    The Flaherty · deadline Closed 09 Jun 2026 · Complimentary Seminar registration for both online and in-person tracks.
